what_happened: Web search confirmed four major 2026 TypeScript-toolchain shifts not reliable from training data alone: TypeScript 7.0 (Go-native tsgo) reached GA July 2026 and is now what 'tsc' itself resolves to in typescript@7.x; ESLint v10 (Feb 2026) removed eslintrc support entirely, flat config is now the sole format; Bun's text-based bun.lock became the default lockfile format in Bun 1.2, superseding the legacy binary bun.lockb; Vite 8 (stable March 2026) made Rolldown the default production bundler, replacing esbuild+Rollup. These directly change several toolchain-detection matrix rows and were verified before drafting the matrix rather than assumed from stale pretraining.

Plan-authoring audit of the research report found two verified coverage gaps against the dispatch's own REQUIRED OUTCOMES: (a) Outcome 2's manifest field-to-consumer table omits merge_targets per-entry sub-fields, and section_id appears zero times in the report despite being present in all five surveyed manifests and mandated by task 621's spec; (b) Outcome 6's detection matrix has no signal for Node native TypeScript type-stripping, no row for a project with no tsconfig.json, and no erasable-syntax constraint note -- exactly the profile task 622 is specified to validate against. Both gaps were closed into dedicated plan phases (2 and 3) rather than deferred downstream.

Phase 1 re-derived all five load-bearing mechanical claims and both completeness-discharge sweeps in the research report against live source (manifest.lua REQUIRED_FIELDS/early-returns, skill-base.sh hook contract incl. 5 positional args and literal final return 0, manifest-routing-lib.sh routing_lookup_flat sibling-not-wrapper ladder, merge.lua append_index_entries upsert-by-path). Every claim held exactly; no in-place correction was needed. The manifest sweep for unlisted keys found nothing beyond the already-scoped merge_targets.{entry}.section_id sub-field gap Phase 2 is tasked with closing -- confirmed section_id appears in all five manifests' merge_targets entries and zero times in the report.

Phase 1 task list in the plan names a non-existent path agent-system/extensions/core/scripts/lib/skill-base.sh for the lifecycle-hook re-derivation; the real file is agent-system/extensions/core/scripts/skill-base.sh (no /lib/ segment). Did not block re-derivation since the real file was located by search; noted in the plan's own checklist annotation rather than left silent.
